services.title: Income Certificate
services.shortDescription: Official government document certifying the annual family income required for scholarships, fee waivers, and welfare schemes.
services.benefitAmount: Mandatory for fee waivers and state/central subsidies
services.spokenSummary: The Income Certificate proves your family annual income. It is required for fee waivers, school admissions, and scholarships. The official fee is fifteen rupees. You need your salary slip or income self-declaration, ration card, and residence proof.

eligibilityCriteria.targetGroup: Any permanent resident citizen or family head
eligibilityCriteria.incomeLimit: No upper ceiling for applying; used to certify any bracket
eligibilityCriteria.residenceRequirement: Permanent resident of the state/district for at least 1 year

questions.question: Are you a permanent resident of this district or state?
questions.explanation: Requires a standard local address proof such as electricity bill or voter card.

questions.question: Do you have salary slips, farm earnings proof, or an income self-declaration affidavit?
questions.explanation: Informal workers can submit a simple self-declaration notarized affidavit.

questions.question: Do you have an active Aadhaar card with updated mobile number?
questions.explanation: Used for e-KYC and digital certificate authentication.

requiredDocuments: Salary Slip, Employer Letter, or Income Self-Declaration Affidavit
Ration Card copy or Family Registry document
Aadhaar Card of the family head
Recent passport-size photograph

documentDetails.name: Salary Slip or Income Affidavit
documentDetails.explanation: Proves your household annual earnings so the government can verify eligibility for fee waivers, scholarships, and welfare benefits.
documentDetails.example: Recent pay slip with employer stamp, or a ₹20 stamp paper affidavit signed by a notary declaring your family’s monthly earnings.
documentDetails.source: Employer for formal workers, or local notary for informal workers (₹20 stamp paper)

documentDetails.name: Ration Card or Family Registry
documentDetails.explanation: Lists all family members living together under one household to compute the total family income accurately.
documentDetails.example: State Food & Civil Supplies ration card (BPL/AAY/APL) showing names of all registered family dependents.
documentDetails.source: Panchayat office or Food and Civil Supplies portal

documentDetails.name: Aadhaar Card of Family Head
documentDetails.explanation: Confirms the official identity, father/spouse name, and residential jurisdiction of the applicant.
documentDetails.example: Physical Aadhaar card, printed letter, or masked e-Aadhaar downloaded from UIDAI.
documentDetails.source: UIDAI Aadhaar Seva Kendra or post office

documentDetails.name: Passport-Size Photograph
documentDetails.explanation: Affixed onto the official revenue office verification record and printed onto the digitally signed certificate.
documentDetails.example: Two recent color photographs (3.5 cm x 4.5 cm) with front-facing pose and light background.
documentDetails.source: Any local photo studio or CSC camera

simpleSteps.title: Gather Income Proof
simpleSteps.instruction: Collect salary slips, village pradhan income letter, or bank statements showing earnings.

simpleSteps.title: Submit Application Form
simpleSteps.instruction: Apply online through your state e-District portal or visit your nearest Common Service Center (CSC).

simpleSteps.title: Revenue Inspector Verification
simpleSteps.instruction: The local revenue accountant (Lekhpal / Talathi) verifies family income status.

simpleSteps.title: Download Digitally Signed Certificate
simpleSteps.instruction: An SMS link is sent to your phone. Download or collect your digitally signed government certificate.

services.title: Caste Certificate
services.shortDescription: Document affirming citizen category (SC, ST, OBC, EWS) to avail constitutional reservations, subsidies, and educational benefits.
services.benefitAmount: Unlocks category reservation quotas and educational benefits
services.spokenSummary: The Caste Certificate verifies your caste category for school admissions, competitive exams, and government job quotas. The fee is fifteen rupees. You need your father or paternal relative caste certificate, school leaving certificate, and Aadhaar card.

eligibilityCriteria.targetGroup: Citizens belonging to notified SC, ST, OBC, or EWS categories
eligibilityCriteria.incomeLimit: OBC non-creamy layer ceiling: ₹8 Lakhs / EWS: ₹8 Lakhs
eligibilityCriteria.residenceRequirement: Permanent resident with ancestral linkage in the state

questions.question: Do you belong to an officially notified community (SC, ST, OBC, or EWS)?
questions.explanation: Official lists maintained by state and central welfare departments.

questions.question: Do you have previous caste proof from your father, grandfather, or paternal uncle?
questions.explanation: Paternal lineage document is the primary evidentiary foundation.

questions.question: Do you possess a School Leaving Certificate or Birth Certificate with community mentioned?
questions.explanation: Confirms personal identity alongside ancestral proof.

requiredDocuments: Paternal family caste certificate (Father, Grandfather, or Uncle)
School Leaving Certificate or Birth Certificate showing caste record
Aadhaar Card of applicant and parent
Affidavit of community lineage

documentDetails.name: Paternal Caste Certificate or Lineage Proof
documentDetails.explanation: Verifies hereditary community membership through paternal lineage under state caste validity statutes.
documentDetails.example: Father’s or grandfather’s official caste certificate, school record with caste entry, or historic revenue settlement record.
documentDetails.source: Previous issued certificate of father or grandfather from Tehsildar

documentDetails.name: School Leaving Certificate / Birth Certificate
documentDetails.explanation: Establishes verified date of birth and the community recorded at initial school admission.
documentDetails.example: School Transfer Certificate (TC) from recognized institution, or Municipal Birth Certificate.

documentDetails.name: Aadhaar Card (Applicant & Parent)
documentDetails.explanation: Legally validates demographic details and father-child or mother-child familial relationship.
documentDetails.example: Clear photocopies of the applicant’s Aadhaar card and the father’s Aadhaar card.

documentDetails.name: Notarized Lineage Affidavit
documentDetails.explanation: A formal sworn declaration affirming the family pedigree tree and undertaking legal responsibility for truthfulness.
documentDetails.example: Genealogy family tree affidavit drafted on ₹20/₹50 stamp paper attested by an Executive Magistrate or Notary.

simpleSteps.title: Locate Family Caste Evidence
simpleSteps.instruction: Keep any previous caste document from your father or grandfather ready as primary evidence.

simpleSteps.title: Submit Online or at Tehsil Office
simpleSteps.instruction: Submit the standardized one-page form at your sub-divisional magistrate (SDM) or e-Seva center.

simpleSteps.title: Field Inquiry Verification
simpleSteps.instruction: Revenue authorities conduct local lineage verification.

simpleSteps.title: Certificate Issuance
simpleSteps.instruction: Obtain the barcoded, digitally verifiable Caste Certificate with lifetime or standard validity.

services.title: Residence Certificate (Domicile)
services.shortDescription: Proof of permanent residence in a state or union territory, essential for state recruitment, quota admissions, and government housing.
services.benefitAmount: Confirms state domicile for local job reservations and admissions
services.spokenSummary: The Residence Certificate proves how long you have lived in your state. It is needed for state college admissions and local recruitment. You need electricity bills, voter identity card, school certificate, and continuous residence proof for the past three years.

eligibilityCriteria.targetGroup: Residents who have stayed in the state continuously for 3+ years
eligibilityCriteria.residenceRequirement: Minimum 3 to 10 years continuous domicile depending on state rules

questions.question: Have you lived in this state continuously for at least 3 years?
questions.explanation: Demonstrated through continuous utility bills or schooling.

questions.question: Do you hold a local Voter ID, Aadhaar, or state ration card with current address?
questions.explanation: Serves as primary address verification.

questions.question: Can you provide a self-declaration confirming you do not hold domicile in another state?
questions.explanation: Citizens are legally entitled to single state domicile at a time.

requiredDocuments: Continuous residence proof for 3+ years (Electricity bill, water bill, or house tax receipt)
Voter Identity Card or Aadhaar Card
Educational certificate from state-recognized school
Self-declaration of domicile

documentDetails.name: 3-Year Utility / Tax Proof
documentDetails.explanation: Proves uninterrupted domicile within the state boundaries for the minimum statutory period (usually 3 to 7 years).
documentDetails.example: Consecutive annual electricity bills, municipal property tax receipts, or registered rent agreement with landlord verification.
documentDetails.source: Electricity board, municipal corporation, or village panchayat

documentDetails.name: Voter ID or Aadhaar Card
documentDetails.explanation: Official government photo identification establishing residence within the local electoral ward or constituency.
documentDetails.example: Election Commission Voter ID card (EPIC) or updated Aadhaar card with local address.

documentDetails.name: School / College Transfer Certificate
documentDetails.explanation: Corroborates formative schooling and continuous educational presence inside the home state.
documentDetails.example: School Leaving Certificate or Class 10 marksheet indicating state school location.
documentDetails.source: Educational institution where studied in the state

documentDetails.name: Self-Declaration Form
documentDetails.explanation: A formal legal statement confirming continuous residence and absence of dual domicile status in another state.
documentDetails.example: Standard e-District Domicile Undertaking form filled and signed by the applicant.
documentDetails.source: Downloaded from portal or obtained at CSC counter

simpleSteps.title: Collect Address Proofs
simpleSteps.instruction: Assemble 3 years of residential utility bills or voter identity records.

simpleSteps.title: File Domicile Application
simpleSteps.instruction: Submit electronically or physically at your local Tehsildar office.

simpleSteps.title: Police or Local Verification
simpleSteps.instruction: Local administrative inspection confirms uninterrupted residential tenure.

simpleSteps.title: Receive Domicile Document
simpleSteps.instruction: Collect the official permanent residence certificate with government QR verification.

services.title: Scholarship Guidance (Pre & Post-Matric)
services.shortDescription: Comprehensive financial support and full tuition fee reimbursement for school, college, and university students from modest backgrounds.
services.benefitAmount: 100% Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Annual Maintenance Stipend
services.spokenSummary: Scholarship Guidance helps students get tuition fees and monthly allowances for school and college. Applying is completely free. You need your current year college bonafide certificate, previous year marksheets, income certificate below two lakh rupees, and your own Aadhaar linked bank passbook.

eligibilityCriteria.targetGroup: Regular students enrolled in recognized school, college, or polytechnic
eligibilityCriteria.incomeLimit: Family annual income under ₹2,50,000 (relaxed for specific categories)
eligibilityCriteria.residenceRequirement: Citizen resident of India studying in affiliated institution

questions.question: Are you enrolled as a regular student in a government or recognized private institution?
questions.explanation: Distance/correspondence courses have separate scholarship quotas.

questions.question: Is your total family annual income less than ₹2.5 Lakhs?
questions.explanation: Supported by a valid tehsildar income certificate.

questions.question: Do you have your own personal bank account linked to your Aadhaar card (DBT enabled)?
questions.explanation: Scholarship amounts cannot be credited to parents accounts.

requiredDocuments: College / School Bonafide Certificate & Fee Receipt
Previous academic year marksheets (minimum passing grade)
Valid family Income Certificate (family income under ₹2.5 Lakhs)
Aadhaar-linked Bank Passbook (Student own account, not parents)

documentDetails.name: Bonafide Certificate & Fee Receipt
documentDetails.explanation: Certifies full-time enrollment in the current academic year and the exact tuition fees paid for reimbursement.
documentDetails.example: Institution letterhead bonafide signed by the Principal/Registrar with seal, plus official college fee challan.

documentDetails.name: Previous Year Marksheet
documentDetails.explanation: Demonstrates academic continuity and satisfaction of minimum percentage criteria required under scholarship rules.
documentDetails.example: Official marks card of Class 10/12 or previous semester exam issued by the Board/University.
documentDetails.source: School board or university examination cell

documentDetails.name: Income Certificate (< ₹2.5 Lakhs)
documentDetails.explanation: Validates that household earnings are within eligible low-income thresholds for tuition waiver.
documentDetails.example: Valid Revenue Department Income Certificate with barcode or digital signature (issued within 1–3 years).

documentDetails.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Passbook
documentDetails.explanation: Enables Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the student’s bank account via NPCI payment bridge.
documentDetails.example: Front page of nationalized bank passbook showing Account Number, IFSC code, and branch seal.

simpleSteps.title: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
simpleSteps.instruction: Create your unique One-Time Registration (OTR) using student Aadhaar number.

simpleSteps.title: Fill Academic & Scheme Details
simpleSteps.instruction: Enter your course, roll number, and upload verified bonafide certificate from college.

simpleSteps.title: Institutional Verification
simpleSteps.instruction: Your school or college nodal officer verifies your enrollment on the government portal.

simpleSteps.title: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
simpleSteps.instruction: Scholarship allowance is credited directly into the student bank account via PFMS.

services.title: Pension Guidance (Senior Citizens, Widows & Disability)
services.shortDescription: Direct monthly financial dignity allowance credited into the bank accounts of senior citizens, surviving spouses, and differently-abled individuals.
services.benefitAmount: ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 monthly recurring direct bank transfer
services.spokenSummary: Pension guidance helps elders above sixty years, widows, and persons with disabilities get monthly pension support directly into their bank account. It is totally free of cost. You need an age certificate, income proof, and bank passbook with Aadhaar link.

eligibilityCriteria.targetGroup: Senior citizens aged 60+, destitute widows, or individuals with 40%+ disability
eligibilityCriteria.incomeLimit: Rural family income < ₹46,080 / Urban family income < ₹56,460 per annum (BPL limit)
eligibilityCriteria.residenceRequirement: Permanent resident of the state for minimum 10 years

questions.question: Are you 60+ years old, a widowed spouse, or an individual with 40%+ certified disability?
questions.explanation: Proof of age or civil surgeon disability certificate required.

questions.question: Does your family belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) or marginal income threshold?
questions.explanation: BPL card or Tehsildar income certificate establishes destitution criteria.

questions.question: Are you free from any other government or armed forces retirement pension?
questions.explanation: Scheme is strictly reserved for unorganized sector citizens without pensions.

requiredDocuments: Age Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Medical Age Certificate for age 60+)
Bank Account Passbook photocopy with clear IFSC & Account Number
Income Certificate (Rural family income below ₹46,000 / Urban below ₹56,000)
Death certificate of spouse (for widow pension) or Disability Certificate (40%+)

documentDetails.name: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
documentDetails.explanation: Confirms applicant has reached the statutory retirement/pension age threshold (60+ years for Old Age Pension).
documentDetails.example: Aadhaar card with full date of birth, Voter ID (EPIC), or District Hospital civil surgeon assessment certificate.

documentDetails.name: Bank Passbook with Aadhaar Link
documentDetails.explanation: Account where monthly financial allowance is disbursed automatically via Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
documentDetails.example: Passbook of nationalized bank, regional rural bank, or India Post Payments Bank with active IFSC.
documentDetails.source: Any nationalized, rural, or postal bank

documentDetails.name: BPL Card or Income Certificate
documentDetails.explanation: Verifies economic destitution / poverty criteria stipulated under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP).
documentDetails.example: Ration card with BPL / Antyodaya status, or Tehsildar-issued low-income certificate.

documentDetails.name: Medical / Death Certificate (if applicable)
documentDetails.explanation: Required exclusively for special categories: 40%+ disability certificate for disability pension, or spouse death certificate for widow pension.
documentDetails.example: Unique Disability ID (UDID) card / CMO Medical Board certificate, or Municipal Death Certificate of husband.
documentDetails.source: Chief Medical Officer (CMO) for disability / Registrar for death cert

simpleSteps.title: Confirm Scheme Category
simpleSteps.instruction: Select Old Age Pension (60+ yrs), Widow Pension, or Divyangjan Disability Pension.

simpleSteps.title: Link Aadhaar with Bank Account
simpleSteps.instruction: Ensure NPCI Aadhaar seeding is active at your bank branch so pension transfers arrive reliably.

simpleSteps.title: Submit Application at Block or CSC
simpleSteps.instruction: Hand in your one-page form at the Block Development Officer (BDO) or Seva Kendra.

simpleSteps.title: Monthly Direct Benefit Transfer
simpleSteps.instruction: Once approved, monthly pension is credited automatically in the first week of every month.

services.title: Ration Card (Food Security Card)
services.shortDescription: Get subsidized monthly grains (wheat, rice, pulses) for your family at your nearest government fair price shop.
services.benefitAmount: Subsidized Food Grains Every Month (5kg per person or 35kg per Antyodaya family)
services.spokenSummary: This service is for making a new ration card. With this card, your family gets food grains from the local ration shop. It is completely free. You need your family Aadhaar cards and residence proof.

eligibilityCriteria.targetGroup: Eligible household families (Antyodaya AAY or Priority Household PHH)
eligibilityCriteria.incomeLimit: Annual income ceiling varies by state (typically under ₹1.5 Lakhs)
eligibilityCriteria.residenceRequirement: Permanent resident with valid family domicile in the jurisdiction

questions.question: Do you have details of the eldest adult woman to nominate as head of household?
questions.explanation: National Food Security Act (NFSA) mandates the woman as head of ration card.

questions.question: Do all family members to be included have individual Aadhaar numbers?
questions.explanation: Mandatory for biometric ration distribution at fair price shops.

questions.question: Confirm that no member listed is currently active on another state ration card.
questions.explanation: National portal conducts automated deduplication checks.

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card copies of all family members
Proof of residence (Electricity bill or voter slip)
Passport size photograph of the female head of family
Active mobile number linked to bank account

documentDetails.name: Aadhaar Cards of All Family Members
documentDetails.explanation: Mandatory under the National Food Security Act to link every household member to prevent duplicate or ghost ration cards.
documentDetails.example: Photocopies of Aadhaar cards of the head of family, spouse, children, and residing elderly parents.

documentDetails.name: Address Proof (Electricity / LPG connection)
documentDetails.explanation: Allocates your household to the appropriate designated Fair Price Shop (ration shop) in your ward or village.
documentDetails.example: Recent domestic electricity bill, LPG domestic cylinder passbook, or registered house tax assessment.

documentDetails.name: Photo of Female Head of Family
documentDetails.explanation: Under Section 12 of the NFSA, the eldest woman aged 18+ is legally recognized as the head of the household on the card.
documentDetails.example: Two recent color passport-size photographs of the female head of the family.
documentDetails.source: Local photo studio or CSC camera

documentDetails.name: Bank Passbook of Female Head
documentDetails.explanation: Used for direct food subsidy cash transfers (DBT) and state welfare grain compensation payouts.
documentDetails.example: First page of bank passbook in the name of the female head showing Account Number and IFSC.

simpleSteps.title: Gather Your Papers
simpleSteps.instruction: Collect Aadhaar cards of everyone in your home and one utility bill or village letter.

simpleSteps.title: Submit at Seva Kendra or Online
simpleSteps.instruction: Visit your nearest Gram Panchayat or apply online through food supply portal.

simpleSteps.title: Receive Acknowledgement Slip
simpleSteps.instruction: Keep the 12-digit application tracking number.

simpleSteps.title: Collect Card
simpleSteps.instruction: Collect your printed ration card from the local fair price shop.

services.title: Ayushman Card (PM-JAY Health Cover)
services.shortDescription: Free cashless hospitalization and healthcare cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled public and private hospitals.
services.benefitAmount: ₹5,00,000 Cashless Health Treatment Per Family Every Year
services.spokenSummary: Ayushman card gives five lakh rupees free medical treatment in major hospitals every year for your entire family. The card is completely free. You only need your Aadhaar card and ration card to generate it instantly.

eligibilityCriteria.targetGroup: Families identified in SECC 2011 deprivation criteria or eligible ration card holders

questions.question: Does your family hold a Priority Household (PHH) or Antyodaya ration card?
questions.explanation: Eligible ration card holders are automatically mapped to PM-JAY.

questions.question: Can you provide Aadhaar fingerprint or face authentication at any hospital kiosk?
questions.explanation: Instant e-KYC verifies your card creation on the spot.

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of each beneficiary
Ration Card / PM-JAY Family ID letter
Active mobile number for OTP

documentDetails.name: Aadhaar Card
documentDetails.explanation: Used for real-time biometric or OTP e-KYC authentication on the National Health Authority (NHA) server.
documentDetails.example: Original Aadhaar card or e-Aadhaar printout with linked mobile number for instant verification.

documentDetails.name: Ration Card or HH ID
documentDetails.explanation: Verifies matching entitlement against the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) database for cashless ₹5 Lakh health cover.
documentDetails.example: State Food Department ration card (NFSA/BPL) or official PM-JAY entitlement letter containing family barcode.

simpleSteps.title: Check Name on Beneficiary List
simpleSteps.instruction: Search your family name on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or ask at the hospital Ayushman Mitra desk.

simpleSteps.title: Biometric e-KYC Verification
simpleSteps.instruction: Give your fingerprint or Aadhaar OTP to verify your identity at the kiosk.

simpleSteps.title: Instant Card Download
simpleSteps.instruction: Your PVC Ayushman Card or digital PDF is generated immediately with zero charge.

services.title: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
services.shortDescription: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to small and marginal farmer families.
services.benefitAmount: ₹6,000 per year (3 Installments of ₹2,000 each in Bank Account)
services.spokenSummary: PM-Kisan gives six thousand rupees every year directly to small farmers in three installments of two thousand rupees. Registration is completely free. You need your land ownership records, Aadhaar, and bank passbook.

eligibilityCriteria.targetGroup: Small and marginal landholding farmer families with cultivable land
eligibilityCriteria.incomeLimit: Institutional landholders and income-tax payers are excluded
eligibilityCriteria.residenceRequirement: Resident farmer with land registered in state revenue records

questions.question: Do you hold cultivable agricultural land registered in your own name (Khasra/Khatauni)?
questions.explanation: Land records must be seeded with revenue authorities.

questions.question: Confirm that no member of your immediate family files income tax or holds high public office.
questions.explanation: Scheme is targeted at marginal agricultural households.

questions.question: Is your bank account linked to your Aadhaar card for Direct Benefit Transfer?
questions.explanation: Installments are released strictly through PFMS Aadhaar payment bridge.

requiredDocuments: Agricultural Land Records (Khatoni / RoR copy showing name)
Aadhaar Card of the farmer
Bank Account Passbook with IFSC and NPCI seeding
Active mobile number

documentDetails.name: Land Record (Khatauni / RoR)
documentDetails.explanation: Proves cultivable agricultural land is legally registered in the farmer’s own name in official state revenue records.
documentDetails.example: Certified computerized Khatauni / Record of Rights (RoR) verified by the village revenue patwari or downloaded from State Bhulekh portal.
documentDetails.source: Revenue Patwari / Village Lekhpal or State Bhulekh portal

documentDetails.name: Aadhaar Card
documentDetails.explanation: Mandatory under PM-Kisan guidelines for bi-annual Aadhaar OTP e-KYC authentication on the national portal.
documentDetails.example: Original Aadhaar card with current mobile number linked for receiving the verification OTP.

documentDetails.name: Bank Passbook (NPCI Seeded)
documentDetails.explanation: Account where ₹2,000 quarterly installments are deposited directly through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge System (APBS).
documentDetails.example: Bank passbook copy with bank official stamp confirming active NPCI Aadhaar seeding for DBT payments.

simpleSteps.title: Check Land Record Verification
simpleSteps.instruction: Ensure your land survey number is verified on your state land registry.

simpleSteps.title: Farmer Self-Registration
simpleSteps.instruction: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in or through your Village Level Entrepreneur (CSC).

simpleSteps.title: Aadhaar e-KYC
simpleSteps.instruction: Complete OTP or biometric e-KYC to keep installments active.

simpleSteps.title: Installment Credit
simpleSteps.instruction: Receive ₹2,000 every 4 months directly into your verified bank account.
